conditionSources.params.*: stored HistoryRecord.params; read time historyParams may add resolved names
conditionSources.date.year: proposed selector adapter calling existing historyDate(record,state).year; not a stored field

deferredContext.historicalClassRoleRelations: Not present in record params generally. Do not infer historical class/role/spouse from current Person. Requires event-time snapshot adapter proposal.

slots.age: params.age, nonnegative integer + 세 in text
slots.label: approved ledgerCategories label
slots.amountExact: moneyWordsFull(entry.amount), positive cash income only; require finite safe integer pennies. Full £/s/d includes remainder pence. Preserve raw signed integer pennies; not resource quantity.
slots.amountAbsExact: moneyWordsFull(Math.abs(entry.amount)), negative cash spending only; require finite safe integer pennies. Full £/s/d includes remainder pence. Preserve raw signed integer pennies.
slots.amountSignedExact: moneyWordsFullDelta(entry.amount); require finite safe integer pennies; full signed £/s/d includes remainder pence, zero ±0d. Preserve account labels and raw signed integer pennies. in_kind amount is monetary appraisal, never resource quantity.
slots.verifiedQuantity: Only approved inKindProducer parser output from sourceRefs.detail; never entry.amount, never amount/current price.
slots.decisionCount: params.count; positive integer number of registry decisions in a season, not money or individual event outcome.
slots.termYears: params.years; positive integer term length at occurrence, not remaining years or proof of repayment.

presentationContract.subjectHeading: Person ActorRef resolved by id at read time in a separate heading; surname/epithet can change. Do not store resolved name. If missing, generic 인물 기록. Household subjects display 가구 기록, never pretend individual.
presentationContract.facts: Display original complete factual line immediately below headline; never omit amount, target, actual choice, injury/death cause, title vs possession distinction. Suppress headline if redundant; must not suppress fact line.
presentationContract.knownBaselineCorrections: GLOSSARY_CORRECTIONS.json + ledger.treasury_turn zero correction must land before release; candidate is not current engine behavior.

famine_relief.quantity: Exactly one sourceRef type=building with detail /^bread:([0-9]+)$/; integer capture is positive bread units
famine_relief.onInvalidQuantity: display saved penny valuation + 수량 미확인; do not derive quantity from amount or current market price

wool_levy.quantity: Exactly one sourceRef type=claim id=wool_levy detail /^fleece:([0-9]+)$/; integer capture is fleece units
wool_levy.onInvalidQuantity: display saved penny valuation + 수량 미확인; floor/cap prevents inverse division from recovering quantity

other.rule: Do not enable until producer and units source-audited. Preserve raw saved amount/resource/sourceRefs; do not reinterpret historical records.
